retry_evidence_summary.why_none_sent_back: In both runs the critic stage recorded retry_skipped='not enough budget left for a retry'. Candidates existed (verdict fail/weak: 5 of 5 in the small-language-models run, 5 of 5 in the carbon-capture run), but the meter's stop_reason was already budget_steps (26 of 36 steps = 0.722 >= 0.7). The retry effect is therefore not measured (n=0).
retry_evidence_summary.verdict_origin: fail verdicts: 8 deterministic (no fetched page) + 1 critic (SLM s2, 6 rubric-2 issues); the weak verdict (carbon s4) came from the critic (2 rubric-2 issues).
retry_evidence_summary.critic_call_note: The critic LLM was called once per run and reviewed only the 1 section with a fetched page; the other 4 sections got deterministic fail verdicts without an LLM call.
